blocks.zh: 無菌液體流路設計：過濾器選型、傳輸模式與滅菌策略
blocks.en: Sterile Fluid Pathway Design: Filter Selection, Transfer Modes and Sterilization Strategy

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解無菌液體流路（Sterile Fluid Pathway）的整體設計邏輯，以及為何每一個設計決策都以無菌保證（Sterility Assurance）為最高優先。
blocks.en: Understand the overall design logic of the sterile fluid pathway, and why every design decision gives top priority to sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 掌握兩種主要產品傳輸方式（過壓法 Overpressure 與泵送法 Pumping）的差異與風險，並能依產品特性選擇適當組態。
blocks.en: Understand the differences and risks of the two main product transfer modes (overpressure and pumping), and select a suitable configuration based on product characteristics.

blocks.zh: 熟悉卡匣式過濾器（Cartridge Filter）與膠囊式過濾器（Capsule Filter）的特性差異，以及其與 SUS 系統的搭配邏輯。
blocks.en: Know the differences between cartridge filters and capsule filters, and how each fits with single-use systems (SUS).

blocks.zh: 了解灌裝持續時間對過濾系統設計的影響，包括生物負荷增殖風險（bioburden replication）與過濾器「穿透生長」（grow-through）風險。
blocks.en: Understand how fill duration affects filtration system design, including the risks of bioburden replication and filter grow-through.

blocks.zh: 掌握過濾器就地滅菌（SIP）、高壓滅菌釜（autoclave）、伽瑪輻射等不同滅菌方式對系統設計的影響。
blocks.en: Understand how different sterilization methods, such as filter steam-in-place (SIP), autoclave and gamma irradiation, affect system design.

blocks.zh: 11.0–11.2 概述：無菌流路設計的核心驅動因素 | Overview & Filtration Design Drivers
blocks.en: 11.0–11.2 Overview & Filtration Design Drivers

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 無菌液體流路（Sterile Fluid Pathway）：指從調配桶（formulation vessel）開始，經過除菌過濾器（sterilizing filter），一路延伸到灌裝點（point of fill）的完整管路系統。這段路徑上的每一個接頭、每一個閥門、每一截管線，都是潛在的汙染風險點。
blocks.en: Sterile fluid pathway: the complete piping system that starts at the formulation vessel, passes through the sterilizing filter and extends to the point of fill. Every connection, valve and length of tubing along this path is a potential contamination risk point.

blocks.zh: 可過濾性（Filterability）：不是所有液體都能輕鬆通過 0.22 µm 除菌濾膜。高黏度、含蛋白質聚集體、或大分子產品容易堵塞（blocking/blinding）濾膜，此時必須設計備援路徑（parallel filter trains）或前置預過濾器（in-line prefilters）。
blocks.en: Filterability: not every liquid passes easily through a 0.22 µm sterilizing membrane. Highly viscous products, products containing protein aggregates, and large-molecule products tend to block or blind the membrane. In these cases, redundant paths (parallel filter trains) or in-line prefilters must be designed in.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像一條城市供水管線：水廠（調配桶）→ 淨水過濾器（除菌過濾器）→ 各家各戶（灌裝點）。若水源混濁（高蛋白產品），一個過濾器很快就會堵塞，所以工程師會設計雙線並聯，讓其中一條清洗時另一條繼續供水。這就是 parallel filter train 的設計邏輯。
blocks.en: Think of a city water supply line: water plant (formulation vessel) → purification filter (sterilizing filter) → individual households (point of fill). If the source water is turbid (a high-protein product), a single filter will clog quickly, so engineers design two lines in parallel so that one can be cleaned while the other keeps supplying water. This is the design logic of a parallel filter train.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 高毒性產品的特殊義務：PUPSIT 完整性測試或濾器沖洗（filter flush）所產生的廢液，必須有專屬廢液收集系統（biocontainment bag、waste system）。若沒有妥善設計，高效能藥（HPAPI）廢液可能汙染環境或員工，這不只是 GMP 問題，更是職業安全問題。設計流路時，廢液動線 = 正常產品動線同等重要。
blocks.en: Special obligations for highly potent products: the waste generated by PUPSIT integrity testing or filter flushing must go to a dedicated waste collection system (biocontainment bag, waste system). Without proper design, HPAPI waste could contaminate the environment or personnel; this is not only a GMP issue but also an occupational safety issue. When designing the fluid pathway, the waste flow path is just as important as the normal product flow path.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若某單株抗體（mAb）在 37°C 下靜置 2 小時後開始出現聚集（aggregation），會對過濾器設計產生什麼影響？你會建議哪些設計對策？
blocks.en: If a monoclonal antibody (mAb) begins to aggregate after standing for 2 hours at 37°C, how would this affect the filter design? What design countermeasures would you recommend?

blocks.zh: PUPSIT 廢液為何需要特別的廢液管理設計？CDMO 在承接高毒性藥物時，這個設計細節應在何時討論？
blocks.en: Why does PUPSIT waste need a specially designed waste management system? When should a CDMO discuss this design detail when taking on a highly potent drug?

blocks.zh: 11.3 產品傳輸方式與其對系統設計的影響 | Product Transfer Modalities and Influence on System Design
blocks.en: 11.3 Product Transfer Modalities and Influence on System Design

blocks.zh: 過壓傳輸（Overpressure）：以無菌氣體（壓縮空氣或氮氣）在桶槽頂部加壓，將液體從底部推出。優點是無機械接觸產品的風險；缺點是壓力控制複雜，若壓力不穩定，直接影響時間壓力充填系統（Time-Pressure）的劑量精度。
blocks.en: Overpressure transfer: sterile gas (compressed air or nitrogen) pressurizes the top of the vessel and pushes the liquid out from the bottom. The advantage is that there is no risk from mechanical contact with the product; the disadvantage is complex pressure control, since unstable pressure directly affects the dosing accuracy of a time-pressure filling system.

blocks.zh: 泵送傳輸（Pumping）：機械式驅動液體移動。蠕動泵（peristaltic）不接觸產品，但有脈動；旋轉葉片泵（rotary lobe）直接接觸產品，可能產生剪切力（shear stress）損傷蛋白質分子。
blocks.en: Pumping: the liquid is moved by mechanical drive. Peristaltic pumps do not contact the product but produce pulsation; rotary lobe pumps contact the product directly and may generate shear stress that damages protein molecules.

blocks.zh: 緩衝桶（Surge Vessel / Sterile Intermediate Vessel）：位於過濾器下游、灌裝歧管上游的中間儲存器。它的存在讓過濾操作速度可以獨立控制，大幅降低過濾器被泵送啟停衝擊的風險。
blocks.en: Surge vessel / sterile intermediate vessel: an intermediate holding vessel located downstream of the filter and upstream of the filling manifold. It allows the filtration speed to be controlled independently and greatly reduces the risk of the filter being subjected to pump start-stop shocks.

blocks.zh: 想像廚房的熱水供應：「過壓法」如同水塔靠重力供水——穩定但壓力受水位影響；「泵送法」如同電動加壓泵——流量可控但有脈動。中間的緩衝桶就像熱水器的儲水槽，讓你在洗澡（灌裝）時不必擔心水塔水位變化（過濾速度）影響水壓（灌裝精度）。有了緩衝槽，兩端操作彼此解耦（decoupled），更容易各自優化。
blocks.en: Imagine a kitchen hot water supply: overpressure is like a water tower supplying by gravity (stable, but the pressure depends on the water level); pumping is like an electric booster pump (the flow rate is controllable but pulsating). The surge vessel in between is like the storage tank of a water heater, so that while you shower (filling) you do not have to worry about changes in the tower's water level (filtration speed) affecting the water pressure (fill accuracy). With the surge vessel, the two ends are decoupled and each can be optimized more easily.

blocks.zh: Table 11.3-1🔍 的關鍵洞察：有無「無菌中間桶」是設計複雜度的分水嶺。沒有中間桶時，過濾與灌裝耦合在一起，任何一端的速率波動都會互相影響（壓力drop、劑量精度）；加入中間桶後，兩個單元操作解耦，各自獨立控制，風險大幅降低——但代價是需要更多空間、更多驗證。這是典型的「設計複雜度換取操作穩定性」的工程取捨。
blocks.en: Key insight from Table 11.3-1🔍: whether or not a sterile intermediate vessel is present is the watershed in design complexity. Without an intermediate vessel, filtration and filling are coupled, and rate fluctuations at either end affect the other (pressure drop, dosing accuracy). With an intermediate vessel, the two unit operations are decoupled and controlled independently, which greatly reduces risk, but at the cost of more space and more validation. This is a typical engineering trade-off: design complexity in exchange for operational stability.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 承接一個 mAb 產品，批量 200L，預計灌裝時間 8 小時，採用時間壓力充填系統（TP filler）。你的工程師提議使用「過壓 + 直接到灌裝歧管（無中間桶）」節省空間。請問：這個設計在長時間灌裝中，過濾端壓力隨著桶槽液位下降時會發生什麼？你會如何修改設計？
blocks.en: A CDMO takes on a mAb product with a 200 L batch and an expected fill time of 8 hours, using a time-pressure (TP) filler. Your engineer proposes "overpressure + direct feed to the filling manifold (no intermediate vessel)" to save space. In a long fill, what happens to the pressure on the filtration side as the vessel level falls? How would you modify the design?

blocks.zh: 11.4 過濾器選型與對系統設計的影響 | Filter Selection and Influences on System Design
blocks.en: 11.4 Filter Selection and Influences on System Design

blocks.zh: 卡匣式過濾器（Cartridge Filter）：濾膜安裝在設備自帶的金屬外殼（filter housing）內，以 O-ring 密封。可就地高壓滅菌（SIP）或移出高壓釜處理後裝回。適用於不鏽鋼固定管路系統，耐久性高，長期使用成本較低。
blocks.en: Cartridge filter: the membrane is installed in a metal filter housing that belongs to the equipment and is sealed with O-rings. It can be steam-sterilized in place (SIP), or removed and autoclaved before being refitted. It suits fixed stainless steel piping systems, is durable and has a lower long-term cost.

blocks.zh: 膠囊式過濾器（Capsule Filter）：濾膜與聚合物外殼一體成型，直接夾接（clamp）到管路上。免裝殼、免 O-ring，特別適合一次性使用系統（SUS）。在無菌製造的 SUS 趨勢下，capsule filter 是主流選擇。
blocks.en: Capsule filter: the membrane and a polymer shell are formed as one unit and clamped directly onto the tubing. No housing or O-rings are needed, which makes it especially suitable for single-use systems (SUS). With the trend toward SUS in aseptic manufacturing, the capsule filter is the mainstream choice.

blocks.zh: 相容性（Compatibility）與吸附（Adsorption）：某些 API（尤其小分子或帶電性蛋白質）會被濾膜或管材吸附，導致實際灌裝濃度低於標示。解決方案是設計「預沖洗體積」（flush quantity），用產品本身先佔據吸附位點（saturation），之後正式生產的產品濃度才能符合規格。這個預沖洗量必須經過驗證，並納入廢棄量（discard）計算。
blocks.en: Compatibility and adsorption: some APIs (especially small molecules or charged proteins) are adsorbed by the membrane or tubing, so the actual filled concentration is lower than the labeled concentration. The solution is to design a pre-flush quantity (flush quantity): the product itself first occupies the adsorption sites (saturation), so that the product concentration in the actual production meets specification. This flush quantity must be validated and included in the discard calculation.

blocks.zh: 「SUS 的過濾器首選」有重要含義：Capsule filter 在 SUS 系統中的主導地位不只是方便性問題——它代表整個流路（transfer line + filter + connectors）可以作為一個預組裝、預滅菌的系統整批引入無菌區，大幅減少組裝步驟和人為操作的汙染風險。這是 Sterility Assurance 邏輯的直接體現。
blocks.en: "The filter of choice for SUS" has an important meaning: the dominance of the capsule filter in SUS is not only a matter of convenience. It means that the entire pathway (transfer line + filter + connectors) can be brought into the aseptic area as a pre-assembled, pre-sterilized system, greatly reducing the number of assembly steps and the contamination risk from human intervention. This is a direct expression of sterility assurance logic.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算思維 Formula Thinking
blocks.en: Formula Thinking

blocks.zh:
預沖洗體積驗證邏輯：

產品損失量 = 管路容積 × 吸附係數 + 過濾器保留體積

驗證要求：
  1. 確定最小沖洗量 → 使出口濃度達到目標規格
  2. 鎖定管路長度上限（過長 = 吸附位點增多）
  3. 鎖定過濾面積（過大 = 保留體積增大）
  4. 沖洗量寫入 SOP，偏差即觸發調查

管路設計黃金原則：越短越好，越細越好（在滿足流量前提下）
blocks.en:
Pre-flush volume validation logic:

Product loss = tubing volume × adsorption coefficient + filter holdup volume

Validation requirements:
  1. Determine the minimum flush quantity → the outlet concentration reaches the target specification
  2. Fix an upper limit on tubing length (too long = more adsorption sites)
  3. Fix the filter area (too large = larger holdup volume)
  4. Write the flush quantity into the SOP; any deviation triggers an investigation

Golden rule of tubing design: the shorter and the narrower the better (provided the flow rate is met)

blocks.zh: 某 CDMO 使用不鏽鋼管路搭配 capsule filter 充填眼科製劑，發現第一批次灌裝初期的濃度偏低約 8%，後段回歸正常。原因最可能是什麼？如何在設計階段預防？
blocks.en: A CDMO uses stainless steel piping with a capsule filter to fill an ophthalmic preparation, and finds that the concentration at the start of the first batch is about 8% low and returns to normal later in the fill. What is the most likely cause? How could it be prevented at the design stage?

blocks.zh: 為何 capsule filter 被稱為「SUS 的首選」？從無菌保證的角度解釋。
blocks.en: Why is the capsule filter called "the filter of choice for SUS"? Explain from the perspective of sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 11.5 過濾器組態替代方案 | Filter Configuration Alternatives
blocks.en: 11.5 Filter Configuration Alternatives

blocks.zh: 三種主要過濾器組態：
blocks.en: Three main filter configurations:

blocks.zh: 串聯（Series）：生物負荷減量濾器 + 除菌濾器，或雙重除菌濾器串聯。後者的好處是若下游濾器完整性測試失敗，可測試上游濾器來救批（batch salvage）。
blocks.en: Series: a bioburden reduction filter plus a sterilizing filter, or two sterilizing filters in series. The benefit of the latter is that if the downstream filter fails its integrity test, the upstream filter can be tested to salvage the batch.

blocks.zh: 並聯備援（Redundant Parallel）：兩條流路各帶一個除菌濾器。當第一條因差壓升高（堵塞）時，切換到第二條繼續灌裝，不需停機。適合蛋白質藥物、大批量產品。
blocks.en: Redundant parallel: two flow paths, each with a sterilizing filter. When the first path becomes blocked (rising differential pressure), filling continues on the second path without stopping. Suitable for protein drugs and large-batch products.

blocks.zh: 預過濾（Bioburden Reduction）：在除菌濾器前加一個孔徑較大（0.45 µm）的預濾器，延長主濾器壽命。
blocks.en: Prefiltration (bioburden reduction): a prefilter with a larger pore size (0.45 µm) is placed ahead of the sterilizing filter to extend the life of the main filter.

blocks.zh: 舊式做法的法規風險（Legacy Configurations）：有些老廠的做法是在生產中途把堵塞的預過濾器拆掉換新，再繼續生產。但 EU GMP Annex 1 的精神明確反對這種做法——在完整性測試後重新打開管路（break into the manifold），等同引入新的汙染風險。FDA 和 EU 在查廠時會特別審視這類設計。CDMO 若有類似舊設計，應主動規劃升級，不要等到查廠才發現問題。
blocks.en: Regulatory risk of legacy configurations: some older facilities remove a blocked prefilter in the middle of production, replace it with a new one and then continue production. The spirit of EU GMP Annex 1 clearly opposes this practice: reopening the line after the integrity test (breaking into the manifold) is equivalent to introducing a new contamination risk. FDA and EU inspectors pay particular attention to such designs during inspections. A CDMO with a similar legacy design should plan an upgrade proactively rather than wait for an inspection to find the problem.

blocks.zh: 並聯備援過濾就像高速公路的雙線道收費站：當第一條通道（過濾器）發生車陣（差壓升高），立刻切換到第二條通道，全程不需關閉高速公路（停止灌裝）。而串聯雙重除菌濾器則像護照查驗後再過海關——兩道關卡都通過，才算真正放行，同時提供了「如果海關（下游濾器）失效，護照查驗（上游濾器）還可補救」的安全網。
blocks.en: Redundant parallel filtration is like a two-lane highway toll station: when the first lane (filter) becomes congested (rising differential pressure), traffic switches immediately to the second lane, and the highway (filling) never has to close. Series double sterilizing filters are like passport control followed by customs: only when both checkpoints are passed is release truly granted, and there is also a safety net: if customs (the downstream filter) fails, passport control (the upstream filter) can still be used to salvage the situation.

blocks.zh: 一個 500L 批次的蛋白質藥物，預計灌裝 10 小時，歷史上有多次濾器提前堵塞的紀錄。你會推薦何種過濾器組態？請說明選擇邏輯。
blocks.en: A 500 L protein drug batch has an expected fill time of 10 hours, and there is a history of filters blocking early on several occasions. Which filter configuration would you recommend? Explain your selection logic.

blocks.zh: 為什麼在完整性測試後「打開管路更換預過濾器」被視為顯著風險？從 SA 決策邏輯說明。
blocks.en: Why is "opening the line to replace the prefilter" after the integrity test considered a significant risk? Explain from the sterility assurance (SA) decision logic.

blocks.zh: 11.6 灌裝持續時間對過濾系統配置的影響 | Duration of Fill and Impact on Filtration System Layout
blocks.en: 11.6 Duration of Fill and Impact on Filtration System Layout

blocks.zh: 兩種延長灌裝時間的失效模式（Failure Modes）：
blocks.en: Two failure modes with extended fill time:

blocks.zh: 生物負荷增殖（Bioburden Replication）：非無菌調配桶中的微生物在長時間靜置中大量繁殖，超過除菌過濾器的攔截能力（LRV 設計上限）。這是過濾前端的風險。
blocks.en: Bioburden replication: microorganisms in the non-sterile formulation vessel multiply heavily during a long hold, exceeding the retention capability of the sterilizing filter (the upper limit of its LRV design). This is a risk at the front end of filtration.

blocks.zh: 「穿透生長」（Grow-Through）：濾膜上游的微生物在長時間過濾中，透過細胞分裂逐步穿越 0.22 µm 濾膜進入無菌側。這是 EU Annex 1 特別關注的隱患，也是為何「過濾時間」必須是驗證的關鍵參數之一。
blocks.en: Grow-through: during a long filtration, microorganisms upstream of the membrane gradually cross the 0.22 µm membrane into the sterile side through cell division. This is a hazard of particular concern in EU Annex 1, and it is why filtration time must be one of the key validated parameters.

blocks.zh: 無菌保留時間（Sterile Hold-Time）：產品完成除菌過濾後，在無菌狀態下可以靜置的最長時間，必須透過微生物挑戰試驗（bioburden challenge）驗證。
blocks.en: Sterile hold time: the maximum time the product can be held in a sterile state after sterilizing filtration; it must be validated through a bioburden challenge study.

blocks.zh: 「穿透生長」好比在一道細沙網（濾膜）前放著一群螞蟻（微生物）。若只是短暫靠近，螞蟻無法通過；但若讓牠們在網前停留很久，牠們持續分裂、增殖、尋找縫隙，最終可能繁殖出能穿越的路徑。這就是為什麼「過濾時間上限」必須被驗證鎖定，且不能隨意延長生產時程。
blocks.en: Grow-through is like a group of ants (microorganisms) placed in front of a fine sand screen (the membrane). If they are only near it briefly, the ants cannot get through; but if they are left in front of the screen for a long time, they keep dividing, multiplying and looking for gaps, and may eventually breed a path that crosses it. This is why the filtration time limit must be validated and locked in, and why the production schedule must not be extended arbitrarily.

blocks.zh: 使用無菌中間桶的設計代價與收益：快速完成過濾（filtration 先過完到無菌桶）→ 消除兩種時間相關失效模式 → 之後慢慢灌裝即可。代價：需要更多潔淨室空間放桶槽，桶槽本身需要 SIP/autoclave 驗證，排氣口的通氣過濾器（vent filter）也需要 PUPSIT 和完整性測試。這是一個「用空間和複雜度換取無菌保證」的典型工程決策。
blocks.en: Cost and benefit of a sterile intermediate vessel design: complete filtration quickly (filter everything into the sterile vessel first) → both time-related failure modes are eliminated → fill slowly afterwards. The cost: more cleanroom space for the vessel, the vessel itself needs SIP/autoclave validation, and the vent filter on its exhaust also needs PUPSIT and integrity testing. This is a typical engineering decision that trades space and complexity for sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 灌裝速度驗證的雙邊要求：速度太慢 → 過濾時間過長（grow-through 風險）；速度太快 → 差壓過高（filter membrane 損傷風險）。因此最小速度和最大速度都必須驗證，不能只驗證一端。
blocks.en: Two-sided requirement for fill rate validation: too slow → filtration time too long (grow-through risk); too fast → differential pressure too high (risk of filter membrane damage). Therefore both the minimum and the maximum rate must be validated, not just one end.

blocks.zh: 你的產品批次 300L，歷史灌裝時間約 12 小時。過濾驗證報告中的「最大過濾時間」設定為 6 小時。你該如何修改製程設計來符合這個限制，同時不影響灌裝時間？
blocks.en: Your product batch is 300 L, with a historical fill time of about 12 hours. The "maximum filtration time" in the filtration validation report is set at 6 hours. How would you modify the process design to meet this limit without affecting the fill time?

blocks.zh: 「無菌中間桶必須在整個灌裝過程中維持正壓」——這個要求的目的是什麼？若正壓喪失，風險是什麼？
blocks.en: "The sterile intermediate vessel must maintain positive pressure throughout the filling process": what is the purpose of this requirement? If positive pressure is lost, what is the risk?

blocks.zh: 11.7 過濾器與過濾管路的滅菌方式 | Sterilization of the Filter and Filter Train
blocks.en: 11.7 Sterilization of the Filter and Filter Train

blocks.zh: 三種過濾器滅菌方式比較：
blocks.en: Comparison of the three filter sterilization methods:

blocks.zh: 伽瑪輻射 SU（Gamma-irradiated SU）：供應商完成滅菌後 RTU 供應，最方便，但需注意自由基（free radicals）殘留可能氧化產品——通常需丟棄最初過濾的產品（initial discard），參見 Section 12.0。
blocks.en: Gamma-irradiated single-use (SU): sterilized by the supplier and supplied ready-to-use (RTU). This is the most convenient, but note that residual free radicals may oxidize the product; normally the initial filtered product must be discarded (initial discard), see Section 12.0.

blocks.zh: 高壓滅菌釜（Autoclave）：移出高壓釜蒸汽滅菌。適合 capsule filter；整套組裝好後一起高壓，無需 SIP 管路。靈活性高，但搬運和引入過程需要雙層或三層袋保護（double/triple bagging）或 RTP 傳遞。
blocks.en: Autoclave: removed and steam-sterilized in an autoclave. Suitable for capsule filters; the whole assembly is autoclaved together, so no SIP line is needed. Flexibility is high, but handling and introduction require double or triple bagging or RTP transfer.

blocks.zh: 就地滅菌（SIP）：管路固定安裝，蒸汽直接通入管路和過濾器滅菌。需要管路設計支援（排水、蒸汽入口、冷凝水排放）。適合不鏽鋼固定管路的卡匣式過濾器。
blocks.en: Steam-in-place (SIP): the piping is fixed in place, and steam is fed directly into the piping and filter for sterilization. The piping design must support it (drainage, steam inlet, condensate discharge). Suitable for cartridge filters in fixed stainless steel piping.

blocks.zh: 連接前滅菌（Pre-sterilization connection）：SA 最優策略是在滅菌前完成所有接口的連接（尤其是下游側），避免滅菌後再接管而引入汙染風險。RTU 供應的過濾器組件需與供應商協調，確保預連接規格符合廠端需求。
blocks.en: Pre-sterilization connection: the optimal SA strategy is to complete all connections (especially on the downstream side) before sterilization, to avoid the contamination risk of making connections afterwards. For filter assemblies supplied RTU, coordinate with the supplier to ensure the pre-connected specification meets the site's needs.

blocks.zh: 伽瑪輻射的自由基問題：聚合物材質在伽瑪照射後會產生自由基，這些自由基可在產品過濾初期溶入液體，導致氧化降解（特別危害含氧敏感性 API 的生物製劑）。行業實務是規定初始過濾的前 X 升產品丟棄，此「丟棄量」必須經過驗證，並在批次記錄中記錄。這直接影響批次的物料損耗計算（yield）。
blocks.en: The free radical problem with gamma irradiation: polymer materials generate free radicals after gamma irradiation, and these can dissolve into the liquid at the start of product filtration, causing oxidative degradation (particularly harmful to biologics with oxidation-sensitive APIs). Industry practice is to specify that the first X liters of product filtered be discarded; this discard volume must be validated and recorded in the batch record. It directly affects the batch material loss calculation (yield).

blocks.zh: 引入方式決定包裝要求：高壓釜滅菌後的組件若需經由人員手動帶入 Grade A 區，需要三層袋（triple bagging），每層在不同潔淨等級環境中去除一層。若有 RTP 系統，則可以單層包裝快速引入，大幅降低汙染風險並提升效率——這是設備投資影響操作流程 SA 的典型案例。
blocks.en: The introduction method determines the packaging requirements: if autoclaved components must be brought into the Grade A area manually by personnel, triple bagging is needed, with one layer removed in each environment of different cleanliness level. With an RTP system, a single layer of packaging allows quick introduction, greatly reducing contamination risk and improving efficiency. This is a typical case of equipment investment affecting the SA of the operating process.

blocks.zh: 過濾器的滅菌與引入就像手術器械的準備流程：高壓蒸汽滅菌（SIP）像院內中央消毒室處理不鏽鋼器械——固定設備、在地完成；伽瑪輻射 SU 則像使用一次性無菌手術包——開封即用但需注意材料的輻射後效應（自由基）；雙層袋引入就像手術器械從消毒室送到手術台途中的多層保護——每進入一個更潔淨的環境，就去掉一層外袋。
blocks.en: Filter sterilization and introduction are like the preparation of surgical instruments: autoclaving (SIP) is like the hospital's central sterile supply department handling stainless steel instruments (fixed equipment, done on site); a gamma-irradiated SU is like a disposable sterile surgical pack (open and use, but mind the post-irradiation effects of the material, i.e. free radicals); and double-bag introduction is like the multiple layers of protection on the way from the sterile supply department to the operating table, where one outer bag is removed on entering each cleaner environment.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 新建一條 SUS 灌裝線，客戶要求使用伽瑪輻射 RTU capsule filter 組件。為避免自由基對蛋白質藥物的影響，你在流路設計和批次操作 SOP 中應如何規劃？
blocks.en: Your CDMO is building a new SUS filling line, and the customer requires gamma-irradiated RTU capsule filter assemblies. To avoid the effect of free radicals on the protein drug, how would you plan this in the fluid pathway design and the batch operating SOP?

blocks.zh: 「滅菌前完成所有連接」（pre-sterilization connection）的原則，對 CDMO 承接新產品的工程設計時間表有何影響？你需要與過濾器供應商提前討論哪些事項？
blocks.en: What effect does the principle of "completing all connections before sterilization" (pre-sterilization connection) have on the engineering design timeline when a CDMO takes on a new product? What items do you need to discuss with the filter supplier in advance?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary (11.0–11.7)
blocks.en: Section Summary (11.0–11.7)

blocks.zh: 設計決策的核心邏輯：無菌液體流路的每一個設計選擇（過濾器類型、傳輸方式、有無中間桶、滅菌方法）都應首先從「無菌保證」出發，商業便利性和操作靈活性次之。
blocks.en: Core logic of design decisions: every design choice in the sterile fluid pathway (filter type, transfer mode, presence of an intermediate vessel, sterilization method) should start from sterility assurance first, with commercial convenience and operational flexibility second.

blocks.zh: 傳輸方式的取捨：過壓法簡單但壓力不穩定可能影響劑量精度；泵送法流量可控但有剪切力和啟停衝擊風險；無菌中間桶解耦過濾與灌裝，大幅降低互相干擾，但增加空間與驗證需求。
blocks.en: Trade-offs in transfer mode: overpressure is simple, but unstable pressure may affect dosing accuracy; pumping gives controllable flow but carries the risks of shear stress and start-stop shocks; a sterile intermediate vessel decouples filtration from filling and greatly reduces mutual interference, but increases space and validation requirements.

blocks.zh: 過濾器選型的現代趨勢：Capsule filter 是 SUS 系統的首選，因其高度整合、易於預組裝、預滅菌，符合 EU Annex 1 精神；卡匣式過濾器適合固定不鏽鋼管路的長期高產能設施。
blocks.en: Modern trend in filter selection: the capsule filter is the first choice for SUS because it is highly integrated and easy to pre-assemble and pre-sterilize, consistent with the spirit of EU Annex 1; cartridge filters suit long-term, high-capacity facilities with fixed stainless steel piping.

blocks.zh: 「穿透生長」是隱形風險：灌裝時間越長，過濾時間越長，微生物穿透濾膜的可能性就越高。過濾時間必須是驗證的關鍵參數，超時即觸發偏差調查。
blocks.en: Grow-through is a hidden risk: the longer the fill, the longer the filtration time and the greater the chance of microorganisms penetrating the membrane. Filtration time must be a key validated parameter, and exceeding it triggers a deviation investigation.

blocks.zh: 滅菌方法影響產品安全：伽瑪輻射雖然便利，但自由基問題必須在設計階段納入「初始丟棄量」的驗證；滅菌前完成所有連接是 SA 最佳實務，RTU 和 RTP 是現代無菌製造的重要工具。
blocks.en: The sterilization method affects product safety: although gamma irradiation is convenient, the free radical issue must be addressed at the design stage through validation of the initial discard volume; completing all connections before sterilization is SA best practice, and RTU and RTP are important tools of modern aseptic manufacturing.
